namPhai.rules: Hóa Lộc, Hóa Quyền, Hóa Khoa, Hóa Kỵ are applied from the Đại Vận stem. Conflicts with natal Tứ Hóa are resolved by interaction.

trungChau.rules: Trung Châu specific transformation tables for certain stems (e.g., Canh/Nhâm) apply. Hóa Kỵ severity is higher.

namPhai.rules: Vô Chính Diệu palace borrows stars from opposite palace fully. Borrowing is structural context, physical stars do not double score.

trungChau.rules: Vô Chính Diệu borrows opposite stars but restricts some specific interactions like Tuần/Triệt blocking. Borrowing is semantic, physical stars do not double score.
